      public State toState()
      Wraps this action in a State that applies it once when scheduled, requiring the owning subsystem and interruptible by default. Lets an ActionSubsystem.Action be scheduled directly by a Scheduler or StateTrigger.
      Returns:
      a new state that runs this action
